name: Industrial & Medical Gases Nigeria Plc
source: Industrial and Medical Gases Nigeria Plc condensed statement of comprehensive income for Jan-Jun 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), thousands scaled to naira. EPS as printed in kobo converted to naira and confirmed against 731,064,000 ordinary shares. Net finance income is stored negative; operating expenses are other expenses, foreign exchange losses, selling and distribution and administrative expenses. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | FY2025 and FY2024 re-read from the audited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 26 of the FY2025 annual report: Finance income 48,350 and Finance expenses 6,253 give a net finance income of 42,097 and Income Tax expense 820,222 (FY2024) replaces a placeholder that broke Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Profit for the year. EPS is the printed basic and diluted earnings per share (162 and 295 kobo).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
nameNote: the statement carried only its ticker as the name; the name is taken from the exchange listing for IMG
